cmp_mixed: These are different kinds of measurement: only what they have in common can be compared.
cmp_none_common: No curve to show: tick results that have curves.
cmp_g_intro: The reference run (★) is the golden sample, a unit known to be good: every other ticked run is checked against it.
cmp_g_overlap: The run must cover at least this part of the golden curve
cmp_g_figures: Figures of the summary: write a tolerance (0.3, or 5% of the golden value) for the ones to check; leave it empty for the others.
cmp_g_save: Keep the reference as golden sample...
cmp_g_bad_tolerance: {figure}: '{text}' is not a tolerance (write a number, or a percentage such as 5%)
cmp_g_need_two: Tick the golden sample (the reference) and at least one other run.
cmp_g_name_prompt: Name of the golden sample (for example the kind of cable)
